entries.claim: Scope table: gmail.readonly is a 'Sensitive scope' that triggers OAuth verification
entries.before: gmail.readonly: Sensitive scope; triggers OAuth verification.
entries.after: gmail.readonly is RESTRICTED: requires restricted-scope verification plus annual CASA security assessment. gmail.modify, gmail.compose, gmail.insert, gmail.metadata, gmail.settings.* and https://mail.google.com/ are also restricted.
entries.evidence: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes - Restricted: mail.google.com, gmail.readonly, gmail.compose, gmail.insert, gmail.modify, gmail.metadata

entries.claim: gmail.send is a sensitive scope that triggers OAuth verification
https://mail.google.com/ is restricted and triggers verification plus security assessment
entries.evidence: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes - 'Read, compose, send, and permanently delete all your email from Gmail.' listed under Restricted

entries.claim: Restricted scopes 'might also need' a security assessment / 'potentially undergo' one
entries.before: Restricted-scope apps may/potentially need a security assessment.
entries.after: Restricted-scope apps (unless exempt, e.g. internal/personal use) must pass an annual CASA assessment by an independent Google-approved third-party assessor, revalidated every 12 months; developer pays the assessor.
entries.evidence: https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13465431 - 'applications requesting access to restricted scopes must undergo an annual security assessment'

entries.claim: Restricted scope verification + security assessment take 1 to 4+ weeks (uncertain, unsourced)
entries.method: Read support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463817 (FAQ) and restricted-scope-verification page on 2026-11-01
entries.after: Google estimates ~6 weeks for restricted scope verification ('several weeks'), not guaranteed; CASA is the final step and can add time. Sensitive: ~10 business days; brand: 2-3 business days.
entries.evidence: https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463817 - Brand Verification '2-3 Business days', Sensitive '10 Business days', Restricted '6 weeks'

entries.claim: Reviews 'typically take several days' (cited from Workspace Marketplace app review page)

entries.after: The quote is about Workspace Marketplace listing review, a separate process. OAuth verification timing: brand 2-3 business days, sensitive ~10 business days, restricted ~6 weeks.
entries.evidence: https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463817 - Sensitive Scope Verification '10 Business days'; Restricted Scope Verification '6 weeks'

verdictCorrection.topBlocker: Most useful Gmail scopes (gmail.readonly, gmail.modify, gmail.compose, mail.google.com) are RESTRICTED: restricted-scope verification (~6 weeks) plus a mandatory annual CASA assessment by a paid third-party assessor.
verdictCorrection.reason: Difficulty 5 is right, but the guide calls gmail.readonly sensitive and the assessment optional. Google's FAQ estimates 10 business days for sensitive-only (gmail.send) and 6 weeks for restricted, with CASA as the final step that can add time. Preparing CASA evidence, fixing findings and the demo video take more than 4-12 hours.

missing: Testing publishing status: max 100 test users; test-user authorizations and refresh tokens expire 7 days after consent - https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/15549945 and https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

Unverified apps show an 'unverified app' screen and are capped at 100 new users over the project's lifetime (cannot be reset) - https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/15549945 and https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463817

Three distinct verification tiers: brand (2-3 business days), sensitive (~10 business days), restricted (~6 weeks); brand verification must be published before data-access verification - https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463817 and https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/production-readiness/sensitive-scope-verification

CASA details: independent Google-approved assessor, Letter of Assessment, reverification at least every 12 months; Google charges no fee but developer pays the assessor directly - https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/production-readiness/restricted-scope-verification and https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463817

Restricted-scope policy requirements: allowed use cases only, Limited Use data rules (no ads, restricted human access/transfers), narrowest-scope justification - https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13464321
Narrower Gmail alternatives: gmail.labels is non-sensitive and gmail.send is only sensitive (avoids CASA) - https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

Demo video must be unlisted on YouTube and show consent screen with app name and client ID in the address bar - https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/production-readiness/sensitive-scope-verification
Exemptions: internal (Workspace org) apps and personal-use/dev apps don't require verification - https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463073
Refresh-token limit of 100 per Google Account per client ID; oldest silently invalidated - https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2
